hunks.baseline: That was when I, who used to fall asleep as if I’d passed out whenever I closed my eyes, no matter where or when, began having nightmares.
hunks.sol: Before that, I could close my eyes anywhere, anytime, and fall asleep as if I’d passed out. Then the nightmares began.

hunks.baseline: Even someone with nerves of steel could only take so much. Cross the line between life and death several times a week, watch people close to you die or get hurt, and sooner or later, you start to fall apart.
hunks.sol: Even someone as thick-skinned as me would start to fall apart after crossing the line between life and death several times a week and watching people close to me die or get hurt.

hunks.baseline: The nightmare that came this time was much the same.
But it was far calmer, sadder, and, in a way, even more welcome than the ones I usually had. Because I met people I missed inside it.
hunks.sol: This nightmare was no different. Yet it felt quieter and sadder than the others—and, in a way, even welcome. Because in it, I met people I missed.

hunks.baseline: “Son. While Dad’s at work, be a good boy and play with Hayeon, okay?”
hunks.sol: “Son. While Dad’s at work, play nicely with Hayeon, okay?”

hunks.baseline: I saw the smiling faces of Cheonsu hyung and the other team members who’d died in the mutation Gate.
hunks.sol: I saw the smiling faces of Cheonsu and the other team members who’d died in the mutation Gate.

hunks.baseline: I got to stand by Kim Butler’s side once more as he panted for breath and tried to comfort me.
hunks.sol: I got to stand beside Butler Kim once more as he struggled for breath and tried to comfort me.

hunks.baseline: When I looked around, I found myself surrounded by a hellscape.
hunks.sol: I looked around. A hellscape stretched out on every side.

hunks.baseline: A familiar face, one more at home in this place than anyone else, came into view.
hunks.sol: A familiar face came into view, one more at home here than anyone else.

hunks.baseline: Michael Silbert’s head sprang into the air as he approached at a leisurely pace.
hunks.sol: Michael Silbert’s head flew into the air as he approached at a leisurely pace.

hunks.baseline: But the smile on his lips and the gleam in his dark eyes didn’t disappear.
hunks.sol: But the smile on his lips and the black gleam in his eyes didn’t disappear.

hunks.baseline: “Take a good look. At this landscape we made together.”
hunks.sol: “Take a good look at this scene we made together.”

hunks.baseline: *Clap. Clap. Clap.* The slow applause rang out, and I clenched my teeth. Flames erupted from my slashing spear and swallowed him.
hunks.sol: *Clap. Clap. Clap.* The slow applause rang out, and I clenched my teeth. Flames erupted from my spear as I slashed diagonally downward, swallowing him whole.

hunks.baseline: A monstrous blaze fed on the blood and countless corpses like firewood, completing the hellscape.
hunks.sol: A great inferno rose, feeding on the blood and countless corpses like firewood, completing the hellscape.

hunks.baseline: The screams of the living rose higher than ever—then faded without a trace.
hunks.sol: The screams of those still alive rose higher than ever—then died away without a trace.

hunks.baseline: Everything was dead. Everything was burning.
hunks.sol: Everything was dying. Everything was burning.

hunks.baseline: The terrible scene before me was something beyond a dream.
hunks.sol: The terrible sight before me was something beyond a dream.

hunks.baseline: I let my spear droop limply and stared blankly as the whole world went up in flames.
hunks.sol: I let my spear droop and stared blankly as the whole world went up in flames.

hunks.baseline: Then I heard the voice of a monster who had stubbornly survived even this calamity.
hunks.sol: Then I heard a monster who had stubbornly survived even this calamity begin to speak.

hunks.baseline: “Do your best to survive to the end. Struggle with everything you have, every moment, until the very last day of this world. That way, you’ll be able to witness this sight with your own eyes, right until—”
hunks.sol: “Please, survive until the end. Struggle with everything you have, every moment, until the very end of this world. That way, you can watch it all with your own eyes—”

hunks.baseline: But the silence that finally came wasn’t an ending. It was the beginning of something new.
hunks.sol: But the silence I’d finally won wasn’t an ending. It was the beginning of something new.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a single word flashed through my mind like a bolt of lightning.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a single word flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: As my senses slowly slipped away, someone’s distant shout reached me and pulled my mind up from the depths of the nightmare.
hunks.sol: As my senses slowly faded, someone’s distant shout caught hold of me and pulled me up from the depths of the nightmare.
“…ppa!”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, a radiant light filled my vision, and I woke from the nightmare.
At last, I saw Hayeon’s face, drenched in tears for some reason.
hunks.sol: Radiant light filled my vision. I woke from the nightmare and finally saw Hayeon’s face, drenched in tears for some reason.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t tell how the rest of the day passed.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t tell how the rest of that day passed.

hunks.baseline: The instant I woke up, Hayeon—the recipient of my unfiltered honesty—smacked my arm with a hand just as sharp as Mom’s.
hunks.sol: Right after I woke up, Hayeon—having been hit with the hard truth—smacked my arm with a hand that stung just like Mom’s.

hunks.baseline: Mom stepped away for a moment, then came hurrying back… There’s no point going on. It’ll only make my mouth tired.
hunks.sol: Mom had stepped away for a moment. When she came hurrying back… Well, there’s no point going on. It’ll only make my mouth tired.

hunks.baseline: If the medical staff who’d been waiting nearby hadn’t insisted she stop, I might have drowned in their tears. I’m only exaggerating a little.
hunks.sol: If the medical staff waiting nearby hadn’t insisted she let them examine me, I might have drowned in their tears. I’m only exaggerating a little.

hunks.baseline: “Um, family members. We need to run some tests first, so please calm down a little…”
hunks.sol: “Um, could the family calm down for a moment? We need to run some tests first…”

hunks.baseline: Mom wouldn’t have budged even if Demon King Asmodeus had come knocking—but a few words from a renowned doctor and healer were enough to make her step back without a fuss.
hunks.sol: Mom wouldn’t have budged even if Demon King Asmodeus had come knocking, but a few words from a renowned doctor and healer were enough to make her step back.

hunks.baseline: Of course, she didn’t forget to clutch their hands and beg them to take good care of me.
hunks.sol: Of course, she made sure to clasp their hands and ask them again and again to look after me.

hunks.baseline: “Please look after my son. Make sure nothing’s wrong with him. And there won’t be any lasting effects, right? I heard from my younger one that Taekyung was talking nonsense as soon as he woke up…”
hunks.sol: “Please take good care of my son. Check if anything’s wrong with him. And there won’t be any lasting effects, will there? My younger one said Taekyung started talking nonsense as soon as he woke up…”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I’m not sure exactly what he said. I was away for a moment when it happened.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I’m not sure exactly what he said. I’d stepped out for a moment.”

hunks.baseline: “Understood. Patient, do you remember what you said?”
hunks.sol: “I see. Do you remember what you said?”

hunks.baseline: “I told her not to cry because she’d look uglier if her makeup ran.”
hunks.sol: “I told her not to cry because she’d look even uglier if her makeup ran.”

hunks.baseline: Hayeon glared at me as if she wanted to kill me, while the medical staff listened with their mouths hanging open. Then they gathered in a corner of the room and started whispering.
hunks.sol: Hayeon glared at me as if she wanted to kill me. The medical staff listened with their mouths hanging open, then gathered in a corner of the room and started whispering.

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. There doesn’t seem to be anything obviously wrong with his body, but… His brain could have been affected. Let’s run a full set of tests.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. There doesn’t seem to be anything obviously wrong with his body, but the aftereffects could have affected his brain. Let’s run a full set of tests.”

hunks.baseline: I’d told the truth and they were treating me like a lunatic.
hunks.sol: I’d told the truth, and they were treating me like a lunatic.

hunks.baseline: And even after completing every test known to this world, I was forced to rest until the next day.
hunks.sol: Even after they’d put me through every test known to this world, I was forced to rest until the following day.

hunks.baseline: Actually, if I’m being honest, it was peaceful for once.
hunks.sol: Honestly, it was peaceful for once.

hunks.baseline: I was stuck in bed for two whole days, without a smartphone or TV, all in the name of resting. But the people I cared about most were right there with me.
hunks.sol: I was stuck in bed for two whole days without a smartphone or TV, all in the name of rest. But the people I cared about most were right there with me.

hunks.baseline: I ate, slept, laughed, and chatted with my family. It felt like a dream.
hunks.sol: I ate, slept, laughed, and talked with my family. It felt like a dream.

hunks.baseline: If not for the nightmare I’d had just before waking up, those days would have been so happy I wouldn’t have felt a hint of anxiety.
hunks.sol: If not for the nightmare I’d had just before waking, I might have spent those happy days without a hint of anxiety.

hunks.baseline: But I already knew.
I couldn’t make that time last any longer.
hunks.sol: But I already knew I couldn’t make them last any longer.

hunks.baseline: If I wanted to stop the unease growing inside me, it was time to step back out into the world.
hunks.sol: If I wanted to quiet the unease growing inside me, it was time to step back out into the world.

hunks.baseline: Mom and Hayeon. The medical staff. And all the friends who didn’t come to visit because they wanted me to rest.
hunks.sol: Mom and Hayeon. The medical staff. All the people who cared enough to let me rest instead of visiting.

hunks.baseline: Even if the others were considerate enough not to tell me what was happening outside, the System wasn’t.
hunks.sol: They might have kept quiet about what was happening outside for my sake, but the System hadn’t.

hunks.baseline: I saw the System notifications I hadn’t had a chance to check and found out: right after Michael Silbert was finished off for good, the World Hunter Federation had appointed me as its new leader while I was unconscious.
hunks.sol: The System notifications I hadn’t had a chance to check told me what had happened. Right after I’d finished Michael Silbert off for good, the World Hunter Federation had appointed me its new Alliance Leader while I was unconscious.

hunks.baseline: *Never thought I’d end up as Alliance Leader, of all things.*
hunks.sol: *Never thought I’d end up playing Alliance Leader.*

hunks.baseline: I’d seen more than once what someone’s ambition, their hunger for power, could bring about.
hunks.sol: I’d seen more than once what someone’s ambition—what a hunger for power—could lead to.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi or Magic Johnson would make several times the leader I could—but if I was the one they chose, then even if I wasn’t ready, I was willing to live up to their expectations.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi or Magic Johnson would make a leader several times better than me. But if I was the one they’d chosen, I was willing to live up to their expectations, even if I still had a lot to learn.

hunks.baseline: But before that, there was one thing I had to take care of.
hunks.sol: Before that, though, there was one thing I had to take care of.

hunks.baseline: “No. You need to rest.”
hunks.sol: “No. Rest.”

hunks.baseline: Hayeon continued, her face set.
hunks.sol: Her expression hardened as she went on.

hunks.baseline: At my sincere request, Hayeon bit her lip.
hunks.sol: At my earnest request, Hayeon bit her lip.

hunks.baseline: Hayeon stared at me without a word, then let out a deep sigh. That meant yes.
hunks.sol: Hayeon stared at me without a word, then let out a deep sigh.
That meant yes.

hunks.baseline: That was the first thing Team Leader Choi said when I saw him after several days.
hunks.sol: That was the first thing Team Leader Choi said when I saw him again.

hunks.baseline: I was sitting on an empty bench. I smiled broadly, glad to see him.
hunks.sol: I was sitting alone on a bench. Glad to see him, I broke into a grin.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi smiled along with me and joked.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Yes. While you were lying comfortably in bed, we were running around like mad.”
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi smiled back and joked, “Yes. While you were lying comfortably in bed, we were running around like mad.”

hunks.baseline: “No need. It’s one of the perks of being the boss. Though the press is desperate to find out about your condition.”
hunks.sol: “No need. It’s one of the boss’s privileges. Though the press is desperate to find out how you’re doing.”

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. I wonder where the news leaked from. I made sure to keep everyone quiet for the sake of your recovery.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. I wonder where the news leaked from. I told everyone to keep quiet so you could rest.”

hunks.baseline: The gesture said he wouldn’t ask any more.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t going to ask.

hunks.baseline: He had a hunch I was keeping some secrets from the others. What mattered more to him was why I’d contacted him just two days after waking up.
hunks.sol: He already suspected I had secrets other people didn’t know about. To him, why I’d contacted him only two days after waking was probably the more important question.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. A week ago, we arrested a number of key figures who had close ties to Michael Silbert. Among them…”
hunks.sol: “Yes. A week ago, we arrested a number of key figures with close ties to Michael Silbert. Among them…”

hunks.baseline: He rattled off names: French President Emmanuel, Swiss Interior Minister Werner, who was almost certain to become the next president, and the head of a massive corporation.
hunks.sol: He listed French President Emmanuel, Swiss Interior Minister Werner, who had been all but certain to become the next president, and the heads of major corporations.

hunks.baseline: Every one of them was a heavyweight who held sway over politics and business around the world.
hunks.sol: Each was a heavyweight in the worlds of politics or business.

hunks.baseline: There were so few Hunters among them because the ones you could call the brains behind it all had either died alongside Michael Silbert that day or been captured.
hunks.sol: There were few Hunters among them. The ones who could have been called their leaders had either died alongside Michael Silbert that day or been captured.

hunks.baseline: “It was a bold and brilliant decision. If you’d let them live, a much larger civil war would have broken out.”
hunks.sol: “It was a bold and excellent decision. If you’d spared them, a much larger civil war would have broken out.”

hunks.baseline: Yes. That was exactly why we couldn’t let the bastards live.
hunks.sol: Yes. That was why I couldn’t let the bastards live.

hunks.baseline: The battle at the National Assembly had been a bloody bargain: their lives to prevent tens, perhaps hundreds, of thousands of others from dying.
hunks.sol: The battle at the National Assembly had been a bloody bargain: their lives in exchange for tens, perhaps hundreds, of thousands of others.

hunks.baseline: But even so, Team Leader Choi never brought up the one thing I wanted to know.
hunks.sol: But Team Leader Choi still hadn’t mentioned the one being I wanted to know about.

hunks.baseline: What had happened to the one person I was worried about. The source of this unease.
hunks.sol: The source of my unease.

hunks.baseline: I looked up at the night sky, thick with stars. No—or rather, I looked at the Main Quest, *Cataclysm*, still hanging there, and continued.
hunks.sol: I looked up at the night sky, thick with stars. No—I looked at the information for the Main Quest, *Cataclysm*, still hanging there, and continued.
